B. Is this measure already running in Kanta-Häme wellbeing services county (or in the Tays university hospital area that treats its patients)?
A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure raise the share of lung cancer patients who get curative-intent treatment, and by how much?
Measure: Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate. A thoracic surgeon from the university hospital sits in the county lung meeting every week and gives a second opinion before a stage I-II patient is refused surgery. Counties without their own thoracic surgeon decide about surgery without one today.
effect_summary_en: An English observational study found more lung cancer operations in hospitals where thoracic surgeons were based than in peripheral hospitals (20.0% vs 11.6%), but the abstract gives no separate figure for surgeons attending the lung meetings.
supported_en: Lau et al. (2013, England) found resection rates of 20.0% in hospitals where surgeons were based and 11.6% in peripheral hospitals.
not_supported_en: The abstract does not show the 2.4-point difference from surgeons attending meetings, and there are no Finnish data.
in_use_summary_en: There is no public sign that a Tays thoracic surgeon sits in Kanta-Häme's lung cancer meeting. Tays Heart Hospital (Sydänsairaala) and Pirha say their own lung cancer team includes a thoracic surgeon, but no page says it reviews Kanta-Häme patients refused surgery.
summary_en: Tays Heart Hospital and Pirha pages say lung cancer treatment is recommended by a team that includes a thoracic surgeon. Tays Cancer Centre says Kanta-Häme's hospital holds its own team meetings and works with Tays, but no page says a thoracic surgeon reviews Kanta-Häme decisions not to operate. A 2013 English study found more operations where surgeons were based (20.0% vs 11.6%), which supports the direction of the assumed effect but not its size.
unanswered_en: I found no page on who sits in Kanta-Häme's lung cancer meeting, or on whether its patients pass through the Tays team.
